decisions.finding: Initial consonant Vav in וַיּוֹדוּ sits at cols 190..165, rows 704..746 of extension-volumeA-561-zoom4-upper-right.png on Line 4. Note is retired with Patah restored to initial Vav -> וַיּוֹדוּ.
